messages:
alex: Quick thread to get buy-in — proposing routing heuristics + a compact trace schema for model-variant fallback. Short sketch below, want quick reactions from eng-platform + eng-runtime before I write an RFC.

maria: TL;DR please :thinking:

alex: TL;DR: route by (customer_tier, region, latency_budget). pick variant with best cost/perf within budget. on capacity/latency regressions, fallback to compatible quantized variant. Emit routing headers + request traces that record decision_reason and candidate list.

ryan: How do we want this surfaced in the console? per-request decision path + cost delta between chosen and fallback would be useful.

alex: Console idea: trace timeline with steps (rule_matched -> variant_selected -> cache_hit -> fallback_applied) and a compact diff showing expected vs actual model and estimated token cost. Example headers runtime would inject: 

```
X-Redwood-Routing: tier=premium;region=eu-west;decision=variant_a;fallback=quant7b;reason=capacity
X-Redwood-Trace: trace_id=tr_1825401234;span=1
```

elaine: We must ensure headers and traces are redacted for PII. No customer IDs in cleartext, and sampled payloads must go through redaction/KMS checks. cc @sam for compliance.

ops-bot: Staging schema routing.v1 deployed to staging. Fields added: decision_reason, variant_candidates, cost_estimate_ms, fallback_flag. Sampling toggles available per-tenant.

maria: UX note: show a breadcrumb in the trace pane (compact) and an expandable 'decision graph' that lists rules evaluated with scores. Also add a small banner when fallback occurs: "Fallback applied — see decision graph".

ryan: Also expose metrics: fallback_rate per-route, median_latency_delta when fallback happens, and a heatmap by tier+region. These will help SRE tune thresholds.

alex: Implementation detail: runtime will emit a structured trace event to /v1/internal/traces. We'll sample full request+response at 0.1% and metadata+headers at 100% (configurable per-tenant). Decision_reason will be enum: {capacity, latency_budget, QoS_policy, explicit_route}.

elaine: Confirm default retention and RBAC for sampled payloads? Need strict defaults for Europe customers.

alex: Defaults: traces metadata 30d, full samples 7d. Access: admin+owner only by default. We will apply automatic PII redaction prior to storage and record redaction_version in trace.

maria: Sounds reasonable. Can you include a small event schema in the RFC and an example console mock? If no major objections by EOD I'll schedule a canary in staging.

ryan: ack :thumbsup:

ops-bot: Canary scheduled for tonight 02:00 UTC.
